title: Batteries are now cheaper than natural gas turbines used at many data centers | TechCrunch
summary: Battery storage is now cheaper than a type of natural gas power plant favored by many data center developers, according to a new report from Wood Mackenzie. Both backlogs have been spiking prices for all new natural gas power plants.
